facts.fact: Gabon and Equatorial Guinea signed a bilateral agreement on interconnection of fibre-optic networks at Mongomo on 10 November 2025, between the two countries' digital-economy ministers, reported by TechAfrica News.

systems.owner: Gabon and Equatorial Guinea digital-economy ministries; ARCEP, SPIN, ANINF, Moov Africa Gabon Telecom and Airtel Gabon took part in the technical work
